messages:
anya: FYI onboarding llama5e via convex-bridge into ptq-int4. Quick smoke shows small summarization drop vs fp32 on news-sum. Repro below.

anya: Repro steps:
```
python tools/convex_convert.py --src=llama5e --out ./llama5e-convex/ --quant ptq-int4 --group 128
./eval/harness --model ./llama5e-convex/ --task news-sum --seed 9 --batch 8
```

sam: Numbers?

anya: Rouge-L about -4.2, short factual hallucinations ~8% (baseline ~2%), ppl +0.52. No crashes.

jia: Quick dump of per-head phase params: layer 4 heads 1/5 show inv_freq ~1.0009x fp32. Tiny but consistent.

natalie: Tiny phase/rotary deltas often amplify autoregressively. Can you run a short logit-ddiff for first 80 tokens and per-head L2?

anya: Launched `./tools/logit_ddiff --ref ./models/llama5e-fp32 --alt ./llama5e-convex/ --len 80 --out /tmp/convex_dd.json`. CI queued job.

ci-bot: Job queued: 9743218888-convex-quant-audit.

ci-bot: Job finished. Divergence onset ~token 12; top-5 mismatch grows 3%->16% by token 34. Heads 1 and 5 highest L2; measured inv_freq ratios ~1.0009.

sam: Quick ablation: apply inv_freq *= 0.9989 on those heads in converted weights and re-run smoke. Also try group-size 64.

anya: Hotpatch applied (inv_freq * 0.9989 on affected heads). Reran smoke: Rouge-L gap down to ~1.1, hallucinations ~3.4%. group=64 had minor effect.

natalie: Action items: 1) add per-head phase sanity check in convex converter (warn if ratio >5e-4), 2) add `--auto-fix-phase` shim to apply tiny corrective multipliers, 3) add 10-sample news-sum smoke to CI for new converts. I'll file MLD-6123 and assign.

jia: I'll PR converter tests + CI smoke. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ci-bot: Closing job 9743218888-convex-quant-audit (artifacts: /ci/artifacts/9743218888/).
